title: Keyboard focus is lost after every vote, undo, load-more and auth submit
Losing-side text in duel history/recent duels is below 4.5:1 [UX-011]
Fixed bottom navigation obscures keyboard-focused controls on mobile
Undo and admin rebuild produce different standings for the same remaining picks [BUG-350]
Concurrent voting deadlocks and returns 500s
Layout shift of 0.65–1.60 as the footer is pushed below the fold
Production accepts a one-character admin password and creates the account
Failed-login username is persisted and logged without a length bound [SEC-103]
Focus ring uses `--playlist-accent` (`#cd8e54`) at **2.40:1** on paper / 2.66:1 on card; default accent is 2.71/3.00:1.
Input/search/select borders (`--color-line #d8cdb6`) are **1.37:1** on paper / 1.51:1 on card.
Small muted labels/placeholders miss 4.5:1: stats facet counts **2.74:1**, your-duels counts 2.74:1, home hints 4.20:1, “30 sec” 4.15:1, duel meta 4.47–4.50:1.
Standings/ranking row `aria-label` omits visible rank/W/D/score; axe `label-content-name-mismatch` on **50 rows** per run.
Auth mode switch has no `aria-selected`/`aria-pressed`; both mode and submit are named “Sign in”.
Admin section nav has no active state (`aria-current`/`aria-pressed` all null).
Admin day-chart buttons are **19.3 × 144 px**; axe `target-size` on 14 nodes.
Scrollable admin “Recent picks” `ul` and table wrappers are not keyboard-focusable.
Signed-out `/duel`, `/your-duels`, `/your-ranking` have no `<main>` landmark; axe `landmark-one-main`/`region`.
`/stats` heading order skips h2→h4 for story-card groups.
Duel controls have duplicate/mismatched names (cover and Listen both “Play 30 second preview…”); pick name omits visible Side/year/genre; Undo omits “Z”.
Loading `/duel` mutates state and silently burns a duel on every refresh
`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` fails with 24 errors
Extractor rejections bypass the JSON error envelope [BUG-006, SEC-107, BUG-310]
NUL bytes in search/login trigger a 500
Spotify/upstream failures surface as a generic 500, including admin start/schedule [BUG-255, BUG-352]
Rebuild replays votes in transaction-start order, not the order they were applied
Undo re-shows the undone duel with the sides swapped [BUG-012, BUG-351]
Season-status outage is shown as “no tape”/empty pages and an endless duel skeleton [BUG-003]
Standings/Stats list-fetch 500s render as empty results with no inline retry
Admin section load failures also render empty-state and “Loading…” copy
Danger-zone success notices never render
Preview backfill says “Fetching…” forever and re-enables immediately
Playlist shows only 6 of 150 tracks with no pagination [BUG-309]
Expired unused invites cannot be revoked from the UI
Disconnected admins get the “connected account must own…” 403
Raw Spotify response bodies are stored and shown in the admin UI
Re-import strips artist/genre data from tracks removed from Spotify, and collides positions [BUG-354]
A 401 from a user access token is never refreshed and is reported as bad app credentials
Backend healthcheck only proves the TCP port is open
No `stop_grace_period`; Docker’s 10s default can kill a 180s import/backfill
`DATABASE_URL` interpolates `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` without URL-encoding
`backup.sh` can leave a truncated `.sql.gz` that looks valid
Restore runs against a live backend
Scheduler has no outbound HTTP timeout; one stalled Spotify call blocks scheduled reveals
Timezone validation costs **32–38 ms** on every matchup/summary (`37.7 ms` vs `5.7 ms` without tz; `pg_timezone_names` scan 35–79 ms).
Fonts are **185 kB / 189 kB transfer = 58–59 %** of page weight (5 files; only 2 preloaded); mobile LCP 2.98–3.74 s.
Main JS **345.6 kB raw / 107 kB gzip**; new `TrackDetailPanel` is duplicated into Chart/Ranking chunks; mobile TBT 99–354 ms.
16-connection pool saturates at 100 voters: matchup p50 **526 ms / p95 753 ms**, 11.7 votes/s, DB CPU only 14–22 %.
Personal ranking replay runs on every ranking/summary/detail request; 1,500 votes → 45.8 ms p50 / 67.6 p95; 25 concurrent → 317 ms p95.
Shared 3-permit `heavy_work` semaphore serialises admin insights/stories and starves public reads (insights p95 904 ms at 2 k; cached chart up to 1.48 s).
`/api/me/duels` default page returns **106 kB** (50 duels × two full tracks + inline art).
CSV formula injection in the standings export [SEC-002, BUG-102]
Logout does not revoke the JWT [SEC-003, BUG-103]
Admin nav active label becomes ink-on-ink while hovered/just clicked (`hover:text-ink` overrides `text-paper` on the ink pill). It is invisible in the sidebar and mobile strip.

Duel primary controls fall below the fold: at 1024×768 both pick buttons are at y=759–807 (below 768); at 1440×900 the cassette bottom and auto-preview toggle are clipped. `RecentDuels` is 306px at ≥1024 instead of capped.
Genre bar-chart labels truncate even on desktop (“ELECTRONIC/…”, “INDIE/ALTER…”), so several are ambiguous despite free space.
Mobile standings/ranking rows are ~120px because trailing W/D/score wraps to a full-width third row; only ~7 rows per screen on a ~6,000px list.
Mobile duel has no visible pick affordance: desktop pick buttons are hidden; only the unmarked title/artist block votes. The prominent controls are preview-only.
Auth errors are announced but not tied to fields
Zero-result filter state is not announced
Search clear button is 20x20
Skip link drops focus to body
Admin tables lack caption/scope
Reveal toast is visual-only
Multilingual title lacks lang/dir
Loading skeleton has no heading/status/aria-busy
Design-page palette/glyph contrast
A 409 from a stale status poll is treated as “all duels done” even when the real error is “voting is paused”.
`cargo fmt --check` fails.
`GET /api/admin/stats` and `getDashboardStats` are shipped but unused.
`/design` ships in the production bundle and is publicly routable.
Invite list is silently capped at 200 with no pagination.
No OG/Twitter/canonical/apple-touch metadata; mono webfont not preloaded.
405 responses are empty and non-JSON.
`/api/` and wrong-case `/API/...` return the SPA HTML with 200.
Missing hashed assets return 404 with `immutable, max-age=1y`.
`/healthz` and `/readyz` omit `Cache-Control`.
Client `X-Request-Id` is echoed and logged unbounded.
429 has no `Retry-After`; successful logins consume the brute-force budget.
Password max is 128 **bytes** but the error says characters (emoji fail).
Unknown `status`/`sort` values silently fall back to defaults.
`%` and `_` are SQL wildcards, not literal search characters (also admin voters/standings) [BUG-264].
Invalid/expired session is treated as anonymous on `/api/tracks/{id}`.
README misses `previews/backfill`, `/api/health`, and misstates the rate-limit IP header.
Personal-ranking ties flip order/rank between requests (HashMap order, no id tiebreak).
`last_compared_at ASC NULLS LAST` deprioritises never-compared tracks; constants (200/40) contradict README (100).
In a 2-track playlist, a served-but-unvoted pair can never be fetched again; reload strands a voter at 0 picks.
“1 matches” in ranking/standings.
“No pick” empty state says “No skipped duels.”
Auto-preview on a cold reload is silently blocked by autoplay policy.
Space cycles to the other preview instead of pausing the current one.
Inline track-detail 500 shows a bare error with no retry.
With no active playlist, standings CSV links stay active and download a JSON 404.
Metadata backfill failure keeps the green “Backfilling…” notice and shows 0/0.
Voters management panel collapses after every action.
Settings goal does not save on Enter; unsaved value remains visible.
Status strip says “No tape loaded” with zeroed stats when `/admin/insights` fails.
32-char username truncates on mobile with no full-name affordance.
Used invite whose user was deleted is labelled “Created …”.
Revoked invites disappear with no revoked state or UI audit trail.
Danger-zone controls are clipped/wrapped; full-reset placeholder shows “Type RESET EVE”.
Re-import resets `started_at` to the re-import time.
Concurrent schedule requests can hit the unique active-playlist index and return 500.
After `invalid_grant`, status still says connected and there is no Reconnect action.
Metadata backfill on a scheduled-only playlist reports a completed 25-track run while writing nothing.
Reaped stale run says “the backend restarted” even when it merely timed out.
Backups are local-only and unencrypted despite containing credential material.
Graceful shutdown does not drain background metadata/preview tasks.
Nginx logs `Referer`, which can contain `?invite=CODE`.
`sampler2.pid` (a test-harness PID) is committed in `119c2ea`.
Inline album art adds ~29 kB per chart page
ILIKE search + double ranking scan
No seen_pairs(playlist_id) index
Admin users LATERAL aggregates and unbounded CSV
Cache entries ~52 kB, clear-all eviction, no ETag
No brotli; woff2 is gzipped
Admin ranking is uncached
15 s status polling + 5 s auth cache
CSV exports build full strings in memory
Duel first load makes two p.scdn.co requests
Track drawer does ~10 queries + full replay per open
`cargo audit` reports RUSTSEC-2023-0071 (`rsa`), present via optional/unlinked SQLx MySQL code.
Spotify access/refresh tokens are plaintext and included in backups.
Shipped nginx is HTTP-only; HSTS is absent; `server_tokens` not disabled.
`X-Real-IP`/`X-Forwarded-For` are trusted if the backend is reachable directly; IPv6 rotation defeats buckets.
Health endpoints disclose version, environment, uptime and DB state.
JWT has no `aud`/`iss`; environments sharing a secret accept each other’s tokens.
Containers lack read-only rootfs, cap drops, `no-new-privileges`, resource limits; app uses DB superuser.
`.env` is `0664` on the host.
Invite codes are logged at INFO and stored in `auth_events.detail`.
Unauthenticated Spotify callback performs a DB delete + WARN per invalid state, unthrottled.
Password policy is length-only (8 chars); no breach list/admin MFA.

Search field is ~92px at 320 with clipped placeholder
Decade card half-empty and legend misaligned
320px six-tab labels nearly collide
Mobile admin nav hides five sections with no affordance
Danger-zone buttons wrap into tall ovals
